title: Evaluation of the fixed module/Ext comparison on its standard resolution
statement: For a scheme X [def-pc-scheme], an O_X-module F [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category], an injective resolution I [def-sp-injective-resolutions] with I = injectiveResolution F, degree p and a module cohomology class x [def-sc-ringed-space-module-cohomology], the constructed comparison [new-module-cohomology-ext-resolution-naturality] equals b.inv(a.hom(x)). Here a and b are supplied isomorphisms with their defining equations: a is the module right-derived resolution isomorphism followed by exact forgetting of homology, and b is Ext precomposition by terminalSourceIso, then siteSectionsObjIso, then the canonical acyclic-resolution comparison of the forgotten augmentation. The augmentation is assumed quasi-isomorphic, as follows from exact forgetting. This assertion concerns only the selected standard resolution, and asserts no compatibility between different resolutions.

source.place: Tag 015E, canonical acyclic-resolution computation; Tag 03FD; evaluation of the explicit construction in ModuleCohomologyExtResolutionNaturality.

proof.text: Substitute the standard-resolution equality hI and the two defining isomorphism equations ha and hb. Unfold moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv, whose explicit ingredients are a, the acyclic-resolution comparison c, the site-sections comparison d and Ext precomposition t.symm. Evaluate AddEquiv.trans and addCommGroupIsoToAddEquiv, and evaluate composite homomorphisms, obtaining t.symm(d.inv(c.inv(a.hom x))). Iso.trans_inv gives the same evaluation of b.inv(a.hom x). The supplied forgotten augmentation is the same as the one in the construction, and proof irrelevance identifies its quasi-isomorphism proof with the supplied proof. No comparison between different resolutions is used, and zero degree, empty schemes and zero coefficients need no separate case.

proof_origin.place: Standard-resolution computation in the explicit comparison, Tags 015E and 03FD.

theorem standard_resolution_formula
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (F : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [EnoughInjectives (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    (I : InjectiveResolution F) (hI : I = injectiveResolution F)
    (hι : QuasiIso
      ((HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex
        (SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) (.up ℕ) 0).inv.app F ≫
        ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)).mapHomologicalComplex
          (.up ℕ)).map I.ι)) (p : ℕ)
    (a : (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj
      ((RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F) ≅
      (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace ⋙
        forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).homology p)
    (b : AddCommGrpCat.of (H F p) ≅
      (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace ⋙
        forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).obj I.cocomplex).homology p)
    (ha : a = (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).mapIso
      (I.isoRightDerivedObj (RingedSpace.globalSectionsFunctor X.toRingedSpace) p) ≪≫
        (((RingedSpace.globalSectionsComplex I).sc p).mapHomologyIso
          (forget₂ _ AddCommGrpCat.{u})).symm)
    (hb : b = (by
      let T := SheafOfModules.toSheaf (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
      let ι := (HomologicalComplex.singleMapHomologicalComplex T (.up ℕ) 0).inv.app F ≫
        (T.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℕ)).map I.ι
      haveI : QuasiIso ι := hι
      exact (Abelian.Ext.precompAddEquiv (terminalSourceIso X) (T.obj F) p).toAddCommGrpIso ≪≫
        siteSectionsObjIso (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) ⊤ (T.obj F) p ≪≫
        (sheafToPresheaf (Opens.grothendieckTopology X) AddCommGrpCat.{u} ⋙
          (evaluation X.Opensᵒᵖ AddCommGrpCat.{u}).obj (op ⊤)).rightDerivedObjIsoOfResolution ι
            (fun n ↦ forgottenInjectiveAcyclic X (I.cocomplex.X n)) p))
    (x : (RingedSpace.moduleCohomology X.toRingedSpace p).obj F) :
    moduleCohomologyExtResolutionEquiv X F p x = b.inv (a.hom x)
